body:
Noelle, the Growth Director, becomes a scheduled Claude agent: Read → Decide → Act → Tell → Measure.
- **Code** puts the context together.
- **Claude** (`ai-run --role brain`, no tools) writes ONE plan.
- **The gate:** code judges every action of that plan (`checkPlan`, src/shared/boss/growth/noelle.mjs), and the Worker runs the same check again.
- **What acts in this PR:** Porch & Party's Studio pieces, decisions to the Growth page, notices, linked verdicts, backlink orders, and the 14-day report. The other accepted kinds (job-target, search-loop, outreach-target) are recorded as decisions on the Growth page; their levers are in the follow-up PR.
- **Removed:** the free-model director (`runGrowthDirector`, `freeModel`, the growth# row writers).

Review class: launch

Forms: none — no form page or form server path is touched by this PR

## How a run starts, stops and resumes
- **The tick:** launchd `com.seq.boss-noelle` ticks every 30 minutes through `mac-window run LIGHT` (10:00-21:59 Central).
- **The slot:** `noelle.mjs due` runs today's slot once, at the first tick after `slotFor(day)`. It never starts at or after 21:00. Thursday's slot is the weekly run, after 14:00.
- **A stopped run** (CLAUDE_LIMIT exit 76, a failed read, a failed act, or ACT_LOST) is retried by a tick two hours later, as its OWN slot, up to 3 tries; after that, tomorrow's slot runs. The Worker allows one plan per slot, so a retry is never mistaken for a replay.
- **No duplicate posts:** pieces queued before the stop are dropped on the resume, because the Studio calendar (read by Central day) shows their days as taken. idem_key holds the Studio write.
- **ACT_LOST:** if the Mac dies between /plan and /done, the next post of that slot finds the row still 'planned'. The Worker closes it [ACT_LOST], the Mac marks the day stopped, and the 2-hour retry runs. A lost day never reads "done".

## Self-review
1. **Abuse and data loss.**
   - Checked: every Worker route behind the machine token (401 test); a forged plan with spend, account, owned-channel post, cap raise, Hicks live edit and an off-roster business (all refused); notices only for keys the gate passed this run; done cannot be re-done; an injected source line cannot close its untrusted block.
   - Deletes: only the 8 growth# rows, by id.
   - Found and fixed: a replay of a still-planned row was silently "done" (now ACT_LOST).
2. **Real output.**
   - Checked: the Notices line (her wording, https links only); the morning lines (did-not-run, 3-days, the 14-day report through putMorningSection); the Schedule row.
   - Found and fixed: the row claimed "changes the owning jobs' targets", which is not built; it now says only what is.
   - Not yet seen: the Growth page change is one sentence (Growth.tsx:107) and I have not rendered it at 320/390 px. The live page check is in the follow-up. The ≥20 P&P pieces at phone size are the live proof after land.
3. **Outage.**
   - Checked: Claude limit = rc 76 → stopped CLAUDE_LIMIT, retried 2 h later; a stale, failed or empty source = a named stop; an unread calendar = CALENDAR_UNREAD, nothing queued; a Studio that cannot be read = NOT READ on all three P&P channels, never an empty calendar (test); the week's call budget spent = stopped whole; no run = NOELLE_DID_NOT_RUN; a failed /done = DONE_FAILED, retried.
   - Removed: noelle.sh's duplicate usage grep. ai-run already maps the notice to 76.
4. **Tests that prove nothing.**
   - 24 mutations, each red (table below).
   - Found: 3 that survived at first (post required, replay, unknown kind) because they were second layers. Fixed with a test for the missing `post`; the replay and unknown-kind rows now break both layers.
5. **Half-built.**
   - Ticked every G line above.
   - Not built, so not promised: the job-target, search-loop and outreach-target levers, G19, the brain lines and SKILL.md. Each is named in the follow-up list.
6. **Logic edges.**
   - 21:00 exactly does not start; a tick 1 minute before the 2 h retry waits; try 3 is the last.
   - A 19:30 Central post counts on its Memphis day, not the UTC day (a real bug, fixed: the Studio query grouped by the UTC date).
   - A reel and a photo set on one day both stand; a second reel is dropped.
   - Corporate outreach is open until 5 Dec of the same year, closed in January.
7. **Design.**
   - No keyword decides meaning: Claude writes the plan, code checks only structure and hard stops.
   - The free-model director is removed, not kept beside the new path.
   - The search-loop engine, grid, sites-audit, scorecard, ai-visibility.sh and review.mjs are reused unchanged (B1).
8. **CI.**
   - The new test files are picked up by the sharded vitest glob (tests/**/*.test.ts).
   - validate:noelle is a step of validate:scans.
   - The PR's own CI is watched before review is asked.

## Mutation proof
| # | Fix | Mutation | Test that went red |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | retry waits 2 h | drop the RETRY_AFTER_MS wait | noelleSession "a stopped run waits two hours, then resumes as a NEW slot" |
| 2 | resume is its own slot | resume with the day's slot time | same |
| 3 | no start at or after 21:00 | drop the LAST_START check | noelleSession "never starts at or after 21:00" |
| 4 | at most three tries | drop the MAX_TRIES check | noelleSession "a stopped run waits two hours…" |
| 5 | the engine format posts as the roster format named | drop the post/kind check in enginePlan | noelleSession "an engine format that does not post as the roster format she named is dropped" |
| 6 | taken calendar days dropped on a resume | ignore calendarDays | noelleSession "drops a piece whose day already holds a Studio post" |
| 7 | the untrusted end mark is neutered | stop replacing the mark | noelleSession "a planted line cannot close its block" |
| 8 | a piece must name its roster format | `if (!post)` skipped | noelle "a piece that names no roster format is dropped" |
| 9 | a throw after the claim marks the row PLAN_FAILED | drop the catch's update | noelleRun "a throw after the slot is claimed marks the row stopped [PLAN_FAILED]" |
| 10 | one run per slot | drop the early prior check AND rethrow the UNIQUE error | noelleRun "the same slot posted twice is ONE run" |
| 11 | an unknown kind is refused | skip the KINDS check AND make the switch default accept | noelle "a spend, an account or an email is not a kind she has"; "an unknown kind is refused" |
| 12 | one test per business per cycle | drop the per-business count | noelle "one test per business per cycle" |
| 13 | her session has no tools | allow a tool / drop --strict-mcp-config | validate:noelle --self-test (9 cases); noelleSession "her session has no tools" |
| 14 | notices only for keys the gate passed | drop `!passed.has(p.key)` | noelleRun "done: one Notices line per NEW thing" |
| 15 | copy checked per piece | check all pieces' text joined | noelle "KMP tagged link, PBS 'Black Bible Stories', DW wrong price" |
| 16 | a test names what, number and stop | skip the shape check | noelle "one test per business per cycle" |
| 17 | corporate window by day, same year | compare months only | noelle "corporate Christmas outreach is open 1 Sep to 5 Dec…" |
| 18 | a new format needs a scorecard row | skip validScorecard | noelle "an unlisted format is published WITH its roster line, scorecard row and notice" |
| 19 | a still-planned replay is ACT_LOST | skip the planned branch | noelleRun "the same slot posted twice is ONE run" (the ACT_LOST half) |
| 20 | Studio days are Central | group by the UTC date | noelleSession "an evening post counts on its Memphis day" |
| 21 | Studio misses recorded | drop missed.push | same |
| 22 | done keeps a named stop's code | map every failure to ACT_FAILED | noelleRun "done: one Notices line…" (stops = ACT_FAILED + POST_NOT_PUBLISHED) |
| 23 | a 'waiting' post is not a miss | drop the waiting exclusion | noelleSession "an evening post counts on its Memphis day…" |
| 24 | her yes opens growth-yes#, never growth# | write growth# | noelleRun "a yes to a new format writes growth-yes#…" |
| 25 | 0378 writes only the duty's wall clock; clockRepair places the instant (2e2a50cb) | keep the `next_due_at = …` line | validate:duty-clock went red (CI job 137976364055 at b3e40106); green locally without it |

Removals with no mutation: the visit floor (MIN_VISITS_FOR_TESTS) and the ai-fix kind are gone. ai-fix is now refused as UNKNOWN_KIND (noelle.test.ts:204); the duplicate usage grep in noelle.sh is gone.
